info.name: NextCC+
info.summary: Load, synchronize and export subtitles in the Nextcloud video player
info.description:
NextCC+ adds local SRT and WebVTT loading, same-folder subtitle discovery and adjustable appearance to the Nextcloud 35 video player.
Use one timing point to shift subtitles or a second to correct drift. Preview the result and export a new SRT or WebVTT copy. Signed-in users with folder write access can save the copy beside the video. Administrators can enable playback and local export on read-only public links.
NextCC+ includes optional OpenSubtitles.com search by title or video hash and links to subtitle websites for manual download and import.
info.author: Dimitrios Kokkotis
